segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily T-zone skin report reduced shine, oil control, and a non-greasy feel even after multiple layers or long workdays.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe the toner as balancing, hydrating in winter while keeping them matte in summer, with no greasy residue.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the toner never broke her out and was gentler than others she tried.

concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily or combination skin report visible oil control, less need to blot, smaller-looking pores, and a matte, shine-free finish through the day.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone, sensitive skin reports fewer active breakouts on her cheeks since starting the toner; two others mention it helps prevent clogged pores and breakouts.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers across skin types report increased hydration without heaviness or a sticky feel, describing skin as more hydrated, plump, and comfortable.
concerns.aging: One review mentions the black rice ferment ingredients as helping to nourish and firm tired-looking skin, though no reviewer reports a concrete before/after aging result.

aspects.libelle: May feel too light for dry or normal skin

extraits.texte: I love this toner so much, I have super sensitive acne prone combo skin and this toner was the only one that NEVER broke me out. It's so gentle and hydrating, and I've notice that when i started using this the amount of active acne/new breakouts on my cheeks had reduced so much. I would absolutely keep buying this product. 100% recommend for acne skin/sensitive skin

This absorbs my oils. Keeps it hydrated & glowy at the same time. It starts milky and nourishing then sinks into your skin leaving it hydrated. No greasy or filmy feeling-even after multiple layers. My face is slightly oily after a 12 hour shift working in the hospital. I usually have to blot my face mid day but haven't since using this. It doesn't have a scent. I dont think you will like it if you have dry/normal skin because of the oil control aspect.

I have combo skin so I need a mix of products throughout the seasons. However, this is a year round staple for me. It gives me enough hydration in the winter while keeping me matte in the summer and throughout a hard day at work.

I've been using this toner consistenty for a few weeks now and have definitely noticed a big improvement. My skin is more hydrated, even, and radiant. I have oily skin so was a bit nervous to try this, but it's not greasy on me at all. Totally recommed giving this a try!
